pages.title: Stitch Stomping Through His Model of San Francisco in Lilo's Bedroom Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Stitch stomping through his model of San Francisco in Lilo's bedroom, lifting one foot above the miniature streets and buildings. A suspension bridge, pointed skyscraper, tiny cars, and a bus surround his spread claws. The bed, floral bedding, lamp, and Scrump doll establish the room behind the coloring sheet's city scene.

pages.title: Gothic Angel Stitch Printable Coloring Page
pages.description: Gothic Angel from Stitch poses in this printable coloring page, with a side-swept fringe, tall ears, pointed claws, and a studded collar carrying a heart-shaped lock. Layered chains cross her upper body, and small fangs show in her smile. The coloring sheet keeps the background plain around broad character sections.

pages.title: Cute Stitch in Frog Costume Printable Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features Stitch in a frog costume, sitting beneath a hood with raised frog eyes while five small frogs gather around his feet. His large ears extend beyond the hood, framing the smiling face. The coloring sheet includes wide costume sections, oval foot pads, and small frog cheeks.

pages.title: Stitch Laundry Day Coloring Page
pages.description: Stitch appears on laundry day in this printable coloring page, standing behind a basket of clothes with a spotted head wrap tied above his eyes. A washing machine and cabinet doors frame the room behind him. The coloring sheet adds basket openings, clothing folds, hinges, and broad diagonal floor tiles.

pages.title: Chef Stitch Baking Kitchen Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows chef Stitch in a baking kitchen, wearing a tall chef's hat while standing beside an oven with his hands behind him. A sink and plain cabinets line the wall. The coloring sheet combines large appliance panels with rounded character areas, small claws, and a few simple kitchen outlines.

pages.title: Stitch Sleeping with Money Coloring Page
pages.description: Stitch sleeps with money in this printable coloring page, hugging a fan of banknotes beneath his chin while resting against two large pillows in bed. More bills lie scattered across the blanket. The coloring sheet contrasts broad bedding and ear shapes with small rectangular notes, simple printed symbols, and gentle fabric folds.

pages.title: Stitch Reading a Book Coloring Page
pages.description: Stitch reads a book in this printable coloring page, peering over its wide open cover while his large ears stretch upward and his feet point forward. Small claws curl around the book's outer edges. The coloring sheet has broad cover panels, rounded foot pads, and a plain background around the seated figure.

pages.title: Musical Stitch Guitar Hawaiian Printable
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows musical Stitch playing a small guitar in a Hawaiian setting, sitting on a rounded chair beneath leaves and tree trunks. His claws rest over the strings and fretboard, with one foot facing forward. The coloring sheet combines broad character shapes with narrow strings, tuning pegs, and chair supports.

pages.title: Stitch Sitting on Chair Coloring Page
pages.description: Stitch sits on a chair in this printable coloring page, resting both hands near the seat's edge while his oversized ears rise beside the curved chair back. A round table and simple wall panels appear behind him. The coloring sheet contrasts broad furniture sections with small claws, foot pads, and crossbars.

pages.title: Lilo and Stitch Sweet Hug Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page captures Lilo and Stitch sharing a hug, with Lilo wrapping both arms around Stitch while both close their eyes and smile. Leaf-shaped patterns decorate Lilo's dress beside Stitch's small claws and rounded belly. The coloring sheet leaves the background plain around the close-up pair.

pages.title: Stitch Holding Frog Coloring Page
pages.description: Stitch holds a frog in this printable coloring page, standing with two long antennae above his head and the frog's limbs hanging across his arms. The pair appears as a small full-length group against an empty background. The coloring sheet adds narrow fingers, small claws, and rounded eye and belly sections.

pages.title: Stitch and Angel Funny Expressions Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Stitch and Angel making funny expressions, with Stitch pulling at his mouth above Angel's smiling face and small flower accessory. Their tilted portraits fill opposite corners, leaving broad ears and paws visible. The coloring sheet emphasizes large face sections, simple chest tufts, and small finger shapes.

pages.title: Lilo and Stitch Bedtime Coloring Page
pages.description: Lilo leans over Stitch at bedtime in this printable coloring page, with Stitch lying on a cushion beneath a wall decorated with a moon and star. Lilo's long hair falls beside their faces as she holds his large ear. The coloring sheet includes broad cushions, window-like panels, and small hand details.

pages.title: Stitch Playing Ukulele Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features Stitch playing a ukulele, closing one eye as he strums the strings while standing on a chair beside its tall back. His other hand grips the fretboard beneath the tuning pegs. The coloring sheet combines broad ears and belly sections with thin strings and simple furniture lines.

pages.title: Cute Stitch Coloring Page Free Printable
pages.description: Stitch sits smiling in this printable coloring page, showing small pointed teeth beneath large eyes as flower heads and leafy sprigs surround his broad ears. His hands rest between his feet, revealing rounded pads and tiny claws. The coloring sheet has clear open character sections with smaller petal and leaf details.

pages.title: Elvis Stitch Playing Ukulele Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Elvis Stitch playing a ukulele, wearing a swept pompadour and high-collared outfit as his claws rest across the instrument's strings. Simple foliage outlines fill the outdoor background behind him. The coloring sheet pairs broad costume and ear shapes with thin frets, tuning pegs, and small finger details.

pages.title: Stitch in Hoodie Coloring Page
pages.description: Stitch wears a hoodie in this printable coloring page, smiling in a close-up portrait beneath large ears as rounded clouds and outlined stars fill the background. Long drawstrings hang from the broad hood, with a pocket visible below. The coloring sheet adds small fabric folds and eye highlights within large open sections.

pages.title: Sleepy Stitch Pajamas Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows sleepy Stitch resting in pajamas, lying back against a pillow with his hands folded over his chest and a floppy nightcap. A round pom-pom hangs beside his head. The coloring sheet keeps the room simple, leaving broad clothing and bedding sections with only a few fabric folds.
